name: Mermaid
description: Renders a Mermaid diagram with a concise accessible name, prose summary, and visible structured text alternative.

keyboard: Tab focuses the native disclosure summary; Enter or Space toggles the text alternative.
ariaRequirements: The rendered diagram has role img and is named by title.
description supplies a concise accessible description.
aria-details points to a visible disclosure containing a complete structured or prose equivalent of the diagram relationships.
The generated SVG is hidden from assistive technology to prevent duplicate, unstructured narration.

title.description: Concise meaningful name for the diagram

description.description: Short prose summary of the diagram purpose and relationships

accessibleDetails.description: Structured or prose equivalent of every material relationship in the diagram

detailsLabel.description: Label for the visible text-alternative disclosure

forbiddenUse: Render a diagram without a complete accessibleDetails equivalent.
Use title alone as the text alternative for a diagram with meaningful relationships.
